tools.name: build_rental_link

No unit is held, no payment is taken and no personal details are accepted. Availability is confirmed on the page or by the office. The person reviews and sends the enquiry.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_availability, get_contact · Private data: get_hours, get_contact, search_site · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_availability, get_contact · Private data: get_hours, get_contact, search_site · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_policies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
